highlights.title: SIREN: Towards End-to-End Extreme-Weather Early Warning with Experience-Grounded LLM Agents
highlights.summary: SIREN automates extreme-weather early warning with LLM agents.
highlights.detail: SIREN aims to bridge the gap in automated end-to-end extreme-weather early warning by leveraging Large Language Model agents. The study introduces SIREN-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the performance of LLM agents in this context.

highlights.title: Beyond Scale and Generation: Understanding Language Model-based Entity Matching
highlights.summary: Study investigates entity matching with language models.
highlights.detail: The study highlights the importance of model variant in bi-encoders, with embedding-oriented variants providing stronger initialization and more favorable representation geometry. It also evaluates cross-dataset transferability and computational cost.

highlights.title: A corrective agentic hybrid RAG and an operations-grounded evaluation for a scientific facility
highlights.summary: APS-RAG platform makes institutional knowledge accessible.
highlights.detail: The APS-RAG platform utilizes a retrieval engine that fuses dense, sparse, and knowledge-graph channels with query-type-adaptive reciprocal-rank fusion. It also features a corrective agentic loop and a native-tool ReAct executor.
